integrity: The analytic proof establishes the operator-theoretic claim. Finite Fourier-section checks are diagnostics, not proof of its infinite-dimensional statements.
scientific_limitations: Continuous Hilbert integral between explicitly weighted L2 spaces only, not an operator on Bergman spaces or a discrete Hilbert matrix.
O-epsilon-four remainder for each fixed positive frequency only; no uniform small-frequency limit.
General periodic Green-kernel norm formula, not an elementary nonzero-amplitude closed form; no independent specialist assessment.
title: Periodic logarithmic modulation of the critical Hilbert integral operator
